System Status Update: Autumn v2 | May 2026 

-- ​Technical Notice:

We are currently addressing intermittent rendering issues affecting the HTML-based toolset and the BRPN real-time viewport. Our engineering team is actively optimizing syntax flow to ensure consistent system performance.

​While interactive data modules have reached a heightened state of stability, real-time UI playback remains under active development. Currently, users may experience session instability approximately 60 seconds post-initialization, with similar interruptions upon subsequent reloads.

​We are prioritizing the resolution of these stability constraints and appreciate your patience as we finalize these improvements.
